Goal: Count how many store reviews mention the term "disappointed". That requires navigating to the Reviews/Rating area (or exporting/parsing review text) and searching review text for the target token. I reviewed each provided helper and judged whether it directly supports locating, exporting, or searching product reviews. Summary of each function and usefulness decision:

1) get_dashboard_summary — Not useful. Captures dashboard widgets and combobox selections (sales/search-term widgets), but dashboards do not reliably contain full product review text needed to count mentions.

2) generate_sales_summary_for_date_range — Not useful. Changes dashboard date range and snapshots sales widgets; not aimed at product reviews or review text extraction.

3) export_dashboard_snapshot — Not useful. Exports raw dashboard innerText; dashboard rarely contains complete review text and this helper is tailored for sales/summary widgets, not reviews.

4) extract_last_orders_csv — Not useful. Extracts Last Orders widget (customers/items/grand total). Orders data is not product review text.

5) summarize_top_search_terms_across_store_views — Not useful. Parses search term widgets, not customer reviews.

6) download_revenue_and_orders_report — Not useful. Produces revenue summary and orders CSV; unrelated to reviews.

7) get_last_orders_csv — Not useful. Wrapper around last orders extraction; not reviews.

8) fetch_recent_orders_csv — Not useful. Lightweight wrapper for orders CSV; not reviews.

9) export_orders_csv — Not useful. Exports Last Orders-style table with optional columns; not review content.

10) save_recent_orders_csv — Not useful. Saves orders CSV to disk; still orders-focused, not reviews.

11) export_revenue_and_orders — Not useful. High-level revenue + orders export; not reviews.

12) download_last_orders_summary — Not useful. Delegates to export_orders_csv and parses orders; not review content.

13) download_recent_orders_csv — Not useful. Convenience wrapper for Last Orders CSV; not reviews.

14) save_last_orders_csv — Not useful. Saves Last Orders CSV; not reviews.

15) export_last_orders_csv_simple — Not useful. Simple wrapper for last orders; not reviews.

16) export_last_orders_for_store_and_range — Not useful. Wrapper for last orders filtered by store/range; not reviews.

17) export_recent_orders_quick — Not useful. Another orders-related convenience wrapper; not reviews.

18) export_customers_csv_via_grid — Not useful for counting review mentions. This exports the Customers grid; customer records generally do not contain full review texts. If the installation stored review summaries in the customers grid (very unlikely), this might help, but the documented behavior and selectors target the customer grid export, not review data. Therefore it is not a reliable tool for counting the occurrences of the word "disappointed" in reviews.

Conclusion and recommended next step: None of the provided helpers directly target the Magento Reviews & Ratings area or export product review text. Therefore, no function in the list is directly useful for reliably counting how many reviews mention "disappointed." To accomplish the task you would need a helper that navigates to the Catalog -> Reviews and Ratings page (typically at an admin path like /index.php/admin/review/ or similar), extracts review text (or triggers an export of reviews), and then searches/filters the review content for the term "disappointed" (case-insensitive). Alternatively, implement a new helper that exports the reviews grid as CSV and then counts occurrences of the token in the review text column.
